title: mcmckit: minimal, plug-and-play MCMC samplers for Python
description:
mcmckit is a compact, dependency-light set of MCMC samplers for Bayesian model updating and inverse problems in engineering, with an emphasis on structural dynamics and structural health monitoring.

Each sampler is exposed as a single-step function with all state passed in and returned explicitly, so the sampling loop stays under the user's control and drops into existing code. Full-run helpers, which are thin loops over the same step functions, are provided for when it does not need to.

It includes random-walk Metropolis-Hastings, MALA and adaptive MALA, RAM, DRAM, Metropolis-within-Gibbs, and Transitional MCMC (TMCMC) with log-evidence estimation. Utilities cover noise estimation, hierarchical models, sequential updating, model comparison and convergence diagnostics, plus opt-in parallel evaluation.

Depends only on NumPy and SciPy, with Matplotlib optional for plotting.
